notes.title: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ Version 1.3
notes.notes:
This version fixes a small laundry list of bugs reported by community member k176! Thank you very much for your support and for taking the time to document them.

[b]Version 1.3 - July 22, 2024[/b]
[list][*] Enemies that can enter boss rooms now poof away when boss is triggered.
[*] Goal cloud no longer uses enemy collision logic; will now simply activate on contact.
[*] Missing end boundary in 4-3 added.
[*] Fixed Moon sometimes spawning inside arena boundaries when summoning artillery.
[*] Fixed being able to jump over the stage boundaries in Moon's arena.[/list]

notes.title: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[list][*]You can now jump on the birds Bob fires.
[*]Minor level modifications.[/list]

notes.title: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ Version 1.1
notes.notes:
A big thanks to everyone who took the time to play my game over the last week. Based on some bug reports and feedback, I've made some minor updates to the game:

[b]Version 1.1 - June 23, 2024[/b]
[list][*]Added option to show FPS.
[*]Performance modifications to visual effects in 2-4, 3-4 and 4-2.
[*]Added Patrons of the Arts to credits.
[*][b]Moon Hood fight fixes:[/b]
[list][*]In Trial Mode, the game now calculates score as normal instead of going to the credits.
[*]Jumping on Moon's decoys during his big dash now destroys them.
[*]Fixed dashing animation sometimes persisting during kick attack, breaking the fight if he teleports after.
[/list][/list]
